NCT's Board Members (The Nobel Family Society)

The Nobel Family Society is a private society of which only the descendants of Immanuel Nobel, father of Robert, Ludvig and Alfred Nobel, are eligible as members. The 4 Nobels of the Nobel Family Society below are NCT's founders and board members.

yN

Michael Nobel Born in 1940

Chairman of NCT Asia, Former Chairman of NCT Switzerland 2007-2009/former Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Nobel Family Society /former Chairman of the Appeal of the Peace Prize Laureates Foundation. Michael obtained his PH D. in pyscho-pedagogy from the University of Lausanne. He is knowledgeable in
the fields of economics and environmentology, has deep ties with Japanese Universities and has been honored with many awards.

Nobel Family Society Members

Gustaf Nobel Born in1950

Appointed Chairman of NCT in Switzerland in Jan.2009.. After studies at University of Lund, Sweden, in marketing and economics he started his career as an international businessman working in more than 15 countries all over the world. Over the last 8 years he has become very much involved in environmental projects
and renewable energy solutions, as well as recycling of refuse, and is an authority in the field.

Peter Nobel Born in 1953

Trustee of NCT in Switzerland.
Peter is a graduate with MSc in Material Science and Engineering from The Royal Institute in Stockholm. Peter is a well-known businessman and entrepreneur. A major part of his experience relates to energy associating product programs, product and technology development activities targeting

environmental concerned segments.

Peter works extensively with supporting clean technologies for environmental improvements and energy saving programs.

Philip Nobel Born in 1970

Trustee of NCT in Switzerland.

In Switzerland Philip studied marketing and economics. He then moved to the Bahamas in 2006 and is currently actively involved in environmental issues all throughout the Caribbean islands; he's an active member of the Bahamas National Trust as well as the Nature Conservancy-group whose aims are to preserve
and to improve the natural environment of the islands and its surrounding waters.
